svg.title: Result budgets and overflow
svg.desc: Nested results have a two-million-character default budget. Guest code selects evidence. The visible formatted result includes value, logs, and diagnostics, with a 50,000-character default budget and a 20,000-character failure ceiling. If it fits, it is returned directly. If overflow retention succeeds, a head-and-tail preview includes a paged artifact hint. If retention fails, the bounded response is an error. Artifact defaults are 32 entries, two million characters each, eight million total, and one-hour idle expiry. See docs/diagram-descriptions.md, Output.
svg.text: Nested data and visible responses have separate limits

g.text: 1. Provider → guest JSON bridge
Nested result budget: 2,000,000 characters.
Provider-specific bounds and truncation also apply.
Guest code filters, transforms, and selects evidence.
2. Guest → formatted MCP response
Value + logs + diagnostics share the output budget.
Default: 50,000 chars; failure ceiling: 20,000.
These are UTF-16 code units, not billed tokens.
Case A · Fits the visible budget
Return the formatted response directly.
No overflow artifact is created.
Case B · Overflow retained
Head-and-tail preview + artifact ID + read hint.
Full formatted response retained temporarily.
artifacts.read({ id, offset, limit }) pages the data.
Case C · Overflow cannot be retained
Return bounded preview and missing-result notice.
Mark the caller-visible response as an error.
Artifact defaults: 32 entries; 2M chars each; 8M total.
Idle expiry: 1 hour; reads refresh last-read time.
Artifacts cannot restore provider-truncated data.
